marks.gloss_en: תא שמע, דאמר רבי זירא אמר שמואל: ליבן סכין ושחט בה שחיטתו כשרה, חידודה קודם לליבונה -- אלמא חבטא קדים
חידוד שאני -- sharpness is different [from a blow]
תא שמע: ליבן שפוד והכה בו נדון משום מכות אש -- אלמא חבטא קדים
התם נמי דברזייהו מיברז, דהיינו חידוד -- there too he pierced with it, which is sharpness
the baraita: one whitened a skewer and struck with it -- it is judged as a burn of fire
והאיכא צדדין? -- but there are the sides [of the whitened blade, which precede nothing]!
בית השחיטה מירווח רווח -- the slaughter-site opens wide
one who whitened a knife [in fire] and slaughtered with it -- his slaughter is valid
horn 1: one whitened a skewer and struck with it -- [the mark] is judged as a boil
the baraita: boil and burn render impure in one week, with two signs -- white hair and spreading
the baraita: struck by wood, stone, pomace, the hot springs of Tiberias, or anything not [heated] by fire -- to include lead from its source -- that is a boil
the baraita: if the boil preceded the burn, the burn nullifies the boil; if the burn preceded the boil, the boil nullifies the burn
the case: there was a half-gris of boil beforehand, and he struck with a whitened skewer and another half-gris came out
horn A: the blow comes first, and the heat comes and nullifies the blow
ותיפוק ליה משום שמנונית דאיסורא! -- derive [the knife's prohibition] instead from the forbidden fat [on it]
a knife of idol worship -- it is permitted to slaughter with it
Rava: sometimes the one who slaughters [with it] is forbidden -- with an endangered animal
